column1: # The «measured» works of README.md: what came of each, and the day its numbers were first recorded in the repo (the commit or development note that first carries them). The site's page /free/en/docs/papers/measured/ quotes each card's «Effectiveness in Mova» beside these two columns. Result is shown as «measured, <result>»: gain; no gain (an idea that gave nothing, or did worse, and is off by default); compared (a model or reference set beside ours); the metric (a measuring instrument, no gain of its own); our score (Mova's result on the benchmark).
